name: liveproof
description: Freelance scam checker + client verification for Cursor. Paste an inbound job offer, hiring email, Upwork invite, or LinkedIn DM — detect MacBook reimbursement scams, unpaid trials, crypto payouts, Telegram-only pressure, and advance-fee scripts before you reply. Alternative to guessing, ChatGPT one-offs, or generic 'is this a scam' prompts. Also: LiveProof person stamp for prove-you're-human links.
